claim: Web Summit Lisbon runs from 9 to 12 November 2026.
Invest.Rio and Maravalley are taking ten startups to Web Summit Lisbon, the second year of this mission.
Gol pays the tickets for the ten startups.
Gol's first intercontinental route, Rio to Lisbon from Galeão, runs five flights a week from 24 November 2026.
Invest.Rio and Maravalley opened the startup call in September 2026 for startups under six years old with fewer than 100 employees, as Startups.com.br reported on 18 September 2026.
Startups.com.br named the ten startups on 26 October 2026, and Correio da Manhã reported the same ten on 25 October.
Maravalley ran a mission to VivaTech in Paris in June 2026 with Business France's delegation.
Daniel Barros is Maravalley's CEO and called the plan "uma via de mão dupla" (a two-way street).
Sidney Levy is president of Invest.Rio.
Luiz Borrego is Gol's CIO and called Rio "um hub internacional estratégico" for the airline.
Of the ten startups, nine are listed on Web Summit's site as Brazilian and sheerME is listed as Portuguese, and all ten have a startup page on Web Summit's site.
Bizuu and AllPetSenior speak in Web Summit's Startup Showcase.
